text:
Elaine: quick heads-up — while doing a small sweep of the Optimize toolkit vignettes i spotted inconsistent SDK snippet params for batching + kv cache. some examples use `max_batch` and others `batch_size`. we should standardize to `batch_size` (that's what the runtime expects).
Raj: thanks for catching. where is the worst offender?
Elaine: the streaming-batch vignette and the migration example in samples/embedding-migration.md. i pasted the snippet below.
Elaine: ```python
# wrong (seen in docs)
client.generate(model='redwood/ggml-small', input='hi', max_batch=8)
# correct
client.generate(model='redwood/ggml-small', input='hi', batch_size=8)
```
Mike: ugh, that explains the integration test flakiness i hit yesterday. client ignored the param.
Olivia: i'm +1 to a small lint rule in the docs repo that flags `max_batch` occurrences. low friction to prevent regressions.
Sam: can we do a quick PR to fix the two files and add a test that renders snippets? i can take the PR if someone opens it.
Elaine: opened draft PR here: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/512 — fixes two snippets and adds a short note in the migration guide.
Docs-bot: build-docs job queued for PR 512 — https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/9876
Raj: i left a tiny comment on the PR about also updating the code sample in the SDK README (examples/batching.md).
Mike: i think we should also add a one-line callout in the Optimize toolkit intro about preferred batching keys (`batch_size`, `kv_prefetch=true`) so readers get the recommendation up-front.
Olivia: created a tiny issue to track the lint: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/178 — it suggests a grep for `max_batch` and `max_batch_size` variants.
Sam: LGTM on PR 512, but can we include a short unit snippet that shows the quant profile compatibility note? e.g. mention that aggressive 4-bit quant profiles may need `batch_size <= 4` for some kernels.
Elaine: added a one-line note in the PR description and a short example block:
Elaine: ```yaml
# quant profile recommendation (docs vignette)
quant_profile: q4_0
recommended_max_batch: 4  # conservative for q4 kernels on older GPUs
```
Raj: perfect. once CI passes i'll merge and cherry-pick to the v1.2 branch for the release notes.
Olivia: after merge i'll follow up with the lint PR. happy to own that.
Mike: leaving a quick reminder to update any hosted example snippets in the Console docs — separate small PR.
Sam: noted. i'll queue a console docs PR after 512 merges.
Elaine: thanks all — nice quick turnaround. :thumbsup:
Raj: thanks!
Docs-bot: PR 512 merged into main by raj — build-docs succeeded. downloadable artifacts: https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/artifacts/512/1
Olivia: opened lint PR linked to issue 178. small grep + test to fail on `max_batch`.
Sam: great. moving the console follow-up to my queue.
Elaine: closing thread once lint is in — otherwise keeping as reference for release notes.
Olivia: will ping here when lint passes. :white_check_mark:
